review_description: I was extremely happy to have a quote done by physical inspection at the property by Mark from Solar 360.Two other quotes were insufficient and innacurate being done by satellite image of our roof. We had a bad experience two years before when organised through another company for solar and on installation day they were unable to fit anywhere near the amount of panels expected, so the whole process was abandoned at that time. Shows the benefit of a physical roof inspection as you suggested. Quoting process was excellent without delay and Mark was always accessible whenever a question needed an answer.Also Solar 360,s installation work was done by excellent trades people who were obviously trained in customer satisfaction. A great job.Everything was organised by Solar 360 at the completion of the install to enable us to be up and running ASAP.We thank Solar 360 for a great job with excellent solar products and a good price given the quality of the products and the complexity of the job on an odd shaped roof.
